steps.name: Follow Platina to Freios
steps.objective: 1. Follow the person introduced to you at the 「Elias Royal Palace」 to the portal leading to the "Mysterious Forest" in Mirgandia.\n2. Follow that person through "Mysterious Forest 2" to the "Void Sea".\n3. Cross the "Void Sea" to reach the "Guild Union".

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text:
Oh, %s! Welcome!
Father! The person you've been waiting for is here!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Ah, %s. I am glad to see you looking well.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: %s, it's been a while!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're Miss Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's a long story, so I'll get straight to the point! I'd like you to travel with me to my homeland!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your homeland, Miss Platina...?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: She tells me she comes from another continent, beyond Jiendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Another continent?!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That's right. The continent I come from is called [Freios].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Freios...!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: %s, accompany Platina to Freios and see the world in which she lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, there are a few things I'd like to ask.

choices.text: 1. Why are you asking me to do this?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I am told the portal that has appeared in Midgard was created entirely by chance.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I had intended to entrust the mission to Sir Levi Arens, captain of the royal guard... But the court mages report that the portal in Midgard is highly unstable, and extremely dangerous for a native of Jiendia to use.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: For adventurers from another world, such as yourself, %s, it should pose no great difficulty.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Besides, Dame Platina appears to have business with you as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ???? (Miss Platina has business with me?)

choices.text: 2. You speak of another continent as though it were another world...

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: You sensed that from my words? You have keen instincts...

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: The name Freios is not unfamiliar to me. It is clearly recorded in our histories. You will find the names Freios, Otros, and other continents there.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Yet for many long years, the people of Jiendia have lived as though those other continents did not exist.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I had thought it was simply because those lands lay too far away for trade... But perhaps there was another reason.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I intend to resolve that mystery through your journey. Overlook nothing you see or hear in this new land.

choices.text: 3. What is your purpose, Miss Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: My purpose...? Ahaha... Please don't look at me so suspiciously.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The moment I met you, %s, I knew. My mission was to guide you, %s, into a world you had yet to encounter, %s.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As a [Holy Order], I have a special intuition.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: One day, I unexpectedly received an oracle from the [Blue Dragon] and set out on a journey. Then a storm swept me here, to the legendary continent of Jiendia... and Xenadia.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: And there, I met you. Perhaps the purpose of this journey of mine is [you].

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This meeting is meant to lead you into a new world.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: And this little journey will one day swell into a mighty wave and carry great meaning.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Perhaps... for the entire world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The world? That's so grand I can hardly imagine it...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, there's no need to take it too seriously!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We need only make the most of the brief time we're given!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: So, won't you join the beautiful young paladin Platina♡ for a short, heart-pounding adventure? >_<

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ... (Does anyone normally call themselves that?)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: (Heart-pounding! That sounds wonderful. I want to go too!)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: (Such a cheerful, outgoing young lady! Perhaps it's her foreign upbringing. If only I were ten years younger, I'd set off on an adventure myself... What a shame.)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Very well. Go to Midgard. In the city center, you will find a portal unlike any you have seen before.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Examine the world beyond that portal carefully, and report back to me.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: May fortune and blessings accompany you on every adventure that awaits!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Dame Platina, our meeting was brief, but most enjoyable. I hope you will visit again.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. I enjoyed it very much as well.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It was lovely meeting you too, Princess Herne. Take good care of yourself, all right?

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Y-yes... You too, Platina. You must visit again! Promise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...That was awfully familiar. They must have become close.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then let's go to this city called Midgard, %s! Lead the way!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: So this is the portal. I can feel magic swirling violently around it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... It does look rather dangerous. Will you be all right, Miss Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: No need to worry about me. I'm sturdier than I look!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... All right. Then... here we go!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oof, I'm dizzy!... Are you all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so. Oh... This place...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm. I've never seen this forest either. Where have we landed...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh dear. Are we lost? Well... let's start walking, at least.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Let's! Hehe, you don't seem nervous at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm used to this sort of thing. Besides...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm? Besides?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air is so refreshing... I have a good feeling about this.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Look! Up in the sky!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...! All those pieces of land are floating in the sky...?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That's my homeland, Freios!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Freios... It's no ordinary continent. I'm amazed.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehe... I surprised you. That was rather fun.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: They say Freios used to be an ordinary landmass surrounded by the sea, just like Jiendia. Not that Jiendia is exactly ordinary... Anyway.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But during the [Age of Myth], a tremendous battle between light and darkness shattered it, leaving it as you see it now.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I don't know the detailed history myself... You can look into it as you travel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then where are we standing now? This doesn't seem to be Jiendia... Is it yet another continent?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm... I think this region may be [Mirgandia].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mirgandia...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The only part of Freios that remained on the ground. As I understand it, the [Gate] leading here was lost long ago, so no one has set foot here in ages.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh... Doesn't that put us in a bit of a predicament?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, I'm sure we'll manage somehow. You said you had a good feeling, didn't you? So do I. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Hearing you say that gives me confidence. Let's keep going!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes! Onward!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Whew, thank goodness we found a working Gate. Hmm... Good! This is a place I know well!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad we've found our way. But what was that enormous portal we just passed through? And where are we?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oh, that's an [Imperial Gate]. This place is the [Void Sea], a sea in the sky filled with magic!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As you can see, Freios is a continent made up of countless sky islands floating in the [Void Sea].

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: So the [Old Empire] built Gates like that all over the world. Even places far away can be reached in an instant through them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are they different from ordinary portals?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Umm... I'm a Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution build, not an Intelligence build. Ask me anything more and th-this is what happens...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa! You startled me!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: There are plenty of mages where we're going. Ask them, and they'll explain it properly.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Here we are at last. This is the headquarters of the Guild Union.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Guild Union...?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We've arrived at the perfect city to begin an adventure in Freios. Now it's time for us to part for a while, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Miss Platina? Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (...If we don't part now, they'll discover %s's existence. I can't put %s in danger yet...!)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Since I'm finally back, I'd better take care of some things I've been putting off. Ahh, I'm so lazy that the work always piles up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... Aw, that's a shame. It would be fun to travel together!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I'll miss it too. I'm so curious about what you'll see and do, %s.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But I have a feeling we'll meet again soon, so let's part with a smile for now. Goodbye, %s! Good luck!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You too, Miss Platina! Goodbye!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Miss Platina is gone. Now I'm alone in this unfamiliar place. It feels just like when I first came to the world of La Tale.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (From here on, I'll have to find my own way. All right—let's get going!)
